mentions.name: beat_counter
mentions.description: This tool generates videos with beat counting from music, serving as the beat-detection step of a dance rhythm training project. Beat detection works reasonably well, though downbeat detection and structuring music into dance counts (e.g., 8 or 6 beats) are still unsolved, and no suitable modern models were found for interpreting music.
mentions.problem: Downbeats are tricky to detect and there are no good solutions for further structuring of music into dance counts; available algorithms seem to be from a previous decade.
mentions.source_excerpt: The first step is beat detection in music - here is my code for generating videos with beat counting: https://github.com/zby/beat_counter (vibe coding warning).
